[/s]A conversion of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16243]DGA and CP-A Animated Festive Winter Tree for Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ mod.
Now uses CP (Content Patcher) and SC (SpaceCore). Compatible with SDV ver 1.6+.

[b]New features:[/b]
[i][color=#fff2cc]✨ Added function to auto detect what recolour mod you have installed and apply applicable recolour option.[/color][/i][i][color=#fff2cc]
﻿✨ Added [b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966][b]Foliage Redone[/b][/url]﻿ as a recolour option.

[/color][/i][color=#fff2cc][size=3]🎄☃️[/size][/color][color=#fff2cc][size=3][/size][/color][size=3][color=#fff2cc]🎄[/color][color=#fff2cc]☃️🎄☃️[/color][color=#fff2cc]🎄[/color][/size][i]
[/i]
A remake of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3929]Animated Festive Winter Tree[/url] mod by Paradigmnomad with a Simple Foliage retexture and various recolours.

On the 4 days before the Feast of the Winter Star festival, all pine trees will have animated holiday lights on them. Optionally, you can also have them on for the entire Winter by changing the option in the config menu. [size=3]🎄[/size]
